title: Contextual Help Mode: Keyboard Navigation & Locale-aware Numbering Probe
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a contextual-help keyboard-first mode for the Console cost/rollout surface that: 1) provides a collapsible, screenreader-friendly help layer; 2) stabilizes tab/arrow key flows across localized numeric formats and right-to-left locales; and 3) surfaces inline contrast hints for low-visibility tokens. The aim is to reduce support friction for new users who rely on keyboard navigation and localized number formats.
acceptance_criteria: Contextual-help mode can be toggled with keyboard (Ctrl+Alt+H) and announced by screenreaders (aria-live polite).
Primary focus order is deterministic across locales: global filters -> timeframe -> route selector -> cost tiles -> scrubber -> rollout variants -> contextual-help pane.
Numeric values render correctly for en-US, fr-FR, ja-JP and do not break keyboard scrubbing or focus traps (e.g., comma vs period grouping handled by aria-labels).
Color token warnings are shown when contrast ratio < 4.5:1 for body text and < 3:1 for decorative badges, with suggested accessible token replacements from the theme palette.
Prototype validated in NVDA (Windows), VoiceOver (macOS), and TalkBack (Android) with notes captured in comments.
prototypes: interactive-proto-v1: keyboard-first walkthrough (Figma prototype, testable with keyboard-only)
interactive-proto-v2: RTL + fr-FR number formatting variant (screenshot set)
comments: 2026-02-12 Maya: Initial PRD + low-fidelity flows uploaded. Focus: accessible discoverability and parity with existing help popovers.
2026-02-14 Arjun: Implemented tab-order baked into prototype; found an issue where scrubber arrow keys weren't preserving localized separators — added aria-label fallback to numeric tokens.
2026-02-16 Accessibility review (Lina Ortega): NVDA readout for the rollout-variant list includes raw formatting; recommended using visually hidden localized aria-labels and role=listbox semantics.

2026-02-17 Engineering review (Samir Gupta): Raised performance concern for live contrast checks on large dashboards. Proposed to run checks only when contextual-help mode is enabled and cache results per route.
2026-02-18 PM review (Jonas Eriksen): Approved moving prototype to user testing with a11y panel; requested adding example copy for pluralization edge cases in pt-BR.
decisions: Use a single global toggle (Ctrl+Alt+H) for contextual-help mode across Console so users can discover the feature without hunting in settings.
Numeric values will include a visible formatted value and an aria-label with an unambiguous machine-readable numeric string (e.g., '1,234.56' visually, aria-label='1234.56').
Contrast checks will use token references (token-name) and recommend higher-contrast token alternatives from the theme rather than runtime color shifting.
Focus ring style for contextual-help mode will be a 3px dashed outline using a high-contrast accent token to help low-vision users find focus quickly.
open_questions: Should contextual-help mode persist across routes or reset on navigation? (tradeoff: persistence improves discoverability; reset reduces surprise for first-time users)
How to surface cost-decimal precision expectations in locales where trailing zeros are commonly omitted?
Do we need a dedicated a11y settings page to expose the toggle and contrast overrides for enterprise customers?
accessibility_tests: NVDA 2025.4 walkthrough: contextual help toggle announced; screenreader reads aria-label number fallback correctly after fix (Lina) — PASS
VoiceOver macOS 2025: focus order verified but stop-on-focus for scrubber required additional tabindex handling — ISSUE OPEN
TalkBack Android 12: contextual-help pane is reachable via D-pad navigation; confirmed aria-live polite messages do not spam — PASS
localization_checks: fr-FR: grouping and decimal separators validated; used non-breaking space for thousands; updated aria-labels to use normalized dot decimal.
ja-JP: simplified number shorteners for large token labels (e.g., '1万' mapped to aria-label '10000').
pt-BR: pluralization examples added to help copy for rollout counts (1 implantação vs 2 implantações).
timeline: Week 1: prototype + internal a11y pass; Week 2: engineering spike + i18n smoke tests; Week 3: moderated user sessions with a11y panel; Week 4: iterate and ship feature flag behind rollout-controls.
